---
title: Sharing and permissions
sidebar_position: 2
---

:::info Required, not yet documented as implemented
The project must support sharing TARA projects with other users so they can
understand the results. Role names and permission rules are not final.
:::

The completed guide will explain who may share a project, how recipients are
selected, what access each role grants, and how access is removed.

No specific role hierarchy, invitation mechanism, or identity provider is
promised by this initial documentation. The permission matrix will be added
after the relevant behaviour has been agreed and tested.
